_comment: Copy this file to config/local.json and fill in your deployment values. local.json is gitignored and always takes priority over default.json.

cse._comment_cse: CSE identity — must be unique per deployment
cse._comment_registrar: Only needed for MN-CSE or ASN-CSE (cse_type 2 or 3). Remove if IN-CSE (cse_type 1).
